description: Read the input rules, allowed values, output shape and pricing for the wanted poster workflow: turn an owned character portrait into a wanted poster lettered with posterName and bounty (bounty is 500 GOLD when empty). Takes no arguments and never starts a run. Use chargen_quote_recipe_wanted_poster to price exact values and chargen_run_recipe_wanted_poster to start this workflow.
name: chargen_get_recipe_wanted_poster
title: Get wanted poster
